I expected this would be like Lethal Tempo, but this is so much more fun. 
I didn't expect to have this much fun. We are using a few mods to improve the vanilla game, but I'm sure a lot of this will be implemented later in the game. 
I think the most important mods we have are one that allows us to keep our save file, so we can always just continue, and not have to start over, the mimic mod, that makes enemies mimic our voices, a few new maps, and ofc "Maxwell" that adds Maxwell as a valuable item. 
The game is absolutely playable vanilla, but I think mods currently add some fun and quality of life functions.

I definitely recommend this to other people with a nice friendgroup to play with :) 
Its definitely worth the money, really fun and quite addictive ;)

This game manages to be a very unique spin on Lethal Company. You're given high mobility and a generous pool of health to avoid enemies with instead of relying on gadgets and communication. You're rewarded for paying attention to your environment and possible hiding spots.

However, I think this game suffers from sticking to Lethal's gameplay loop too closely. It wants you to conserve your limited stamina and avoid getting killed, but chickens out from being too brutal by giving you infinite, easy mid-round revives and enemies that don't feel like a real threat. They should commit fully to making a wacky, cartoonish game instead of trying to jam in Lethal's game philosophy without any of the stuff that makes it interesting.

TL;DR: Cool game, very unique take especially visually, but gameplay suffers from sticking too close to the Lethal Company loop but without threatening monsters or real danger, making it get repetitive fairly quickly.
